title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2014-1367 located at 12450 Mason Avenue, southerly of Sesnon Boulevard.
text:
[Council File 26-1482; CD 12]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2014-1367 located at 12450 Mason Avenue, southerly of Sesnon Boulevard.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2014-1367, located at 12450 Mason Avenue, southerly of Sesnon Boulevard.
Owner: Los Angeles Unifed School District; Surveyor: Robert L. Wheeler
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
